text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, asked to lend a hand with something,
I went out shopping with Casino Drive.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth... I received a letter from "that person."
A letter of encouragement, sent to me all the way here in Japan.
choice_data_list: By "that person," do you mean...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Yes, she achieved so much at such a young age... She's someone I truly admire.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As a token of my gratitude, I would like to reply on traditional Japanese stationery...
Do you happen to know a good shop?
choice_data_list: I see, in that case――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This is amazing! It has a much more traditional Japanese
taste than other stationery shops……!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Trainer, what is that card?
It seems to be folded up, but...
choice_data_list: Hehehe, once you open this――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This is…… a Japanese festival!
It's a pop-up message card.
choice_data_list: They have a huge selection! Let's check it all out!
They have a huge selection! Let's check it all out!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Letter paper made from Japanese washi... Excellent.
The floral drawing underneath is lovely too—oh?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This flower is different from the one we saw earlier…… A different pattern, perhaps?
My, this is quite a dilemma.
choice_data_list: Do you have a particular preference for floral patterns?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――The language of flowers.
Actually, some flowers have different meanings
in Japan compared to America.
choice_data_list: Huh, is that so?
Huh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For such important letter paper, I want to make a balanced choice
based on the floral languages of both countries. In that case――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I will research the floral language of every pattern.
Separately for Japan and America.
choice_data_list: What?! There are like 30 different patterns?!
What?! There are like 30 different patterns?!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Research like this is my forte,
so I won't take up much of your time.
Besides――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It is a gift for "that person."
I want every single detail to be immaculate, after all.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Well then, would you mind waiting for me?
It should only take about thirty minutes.
choice_data_list: No, no, I'll help out too!
No, no, I'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us looked up the language of flowers...
and ultimately bought cherry blossom-patterned stationery.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your help.
Thanks to you, it looks like it'll make a wonderful present.
choice_data_list: I'm sure your senior will be thrilled, too.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I only hope it serves as some repayment.
They truly took such good care of me, after all.
choice_data_list: Kind of like a master/apprentice dynamic?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a mentor... she was truly my hero.
She showed my young self the path I ought to follow.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The day after "that person" won a certain graded race...
She came over and spoke to me――

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text:
"Casino, did I hear you won the kids' race
yesterday? That's amazing!"

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text:
"You truly do have talent.
There will surely be much expected of you moving forward."

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text:
"Keep on challenging yourself, Casino!
Take on every expectation and hurdle, and break right through!
If you do that――"

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text: "You can become the greatest Umamusume in the world!"

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not joking, I'm absolutely certain!
I'll be waiting for you... out on the turf!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—A brilliance as dazzling as the sun.
Even now, I can never forget it.
choice_data_list: She really looks up to her, doesn't she?
She really looks up to her, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Yes, after that, 'she' racked up graded stakes win after win... and became a true star.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Her back as she performs has always been my guiding light.
That overwhelming power, and the spirit that weaves the future—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: That's seriously so cool!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Her race footage is absolutely the coolest! Powerful, with a stride that shakes the very earth!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Like a shooting star blazing across the sand!
When I was little, I'd try to imitate her stride and everything――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I've repeated the DVD over and over again, too!
Let's watch it together next time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Casino Drive seemed somewhat brighter than usual.
With her sparkling expression, she looked just like an innocent child.
choice_data_list: Haha…… You must really love it.
Fufu…… You must really love it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――In short, we should look to overseas races for reference.
I am certain it will grant us new knowledge.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Daily study is crucial, and from now on,
I must deepen my analysis from a worldwide perspective.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
And feeding those absorbed methods back
into your assigned Umamusume is your mission.
――Understood?
choice_data_list: U-Understood...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I thought I had caught a glimpse of a rare side of her... she immediately returned to her usual self.
